protocol.alpha_split_convention: alpha/2 = 0.025 passed independently to each law-side call; the lower method's internal convention is owned by tv_lower_bound
protocol.alphabet_source: a-priori protocol grid (2*M)^k; realized support was not used

guarantees.eps_hi: finite-sample, distribution-free upper bound on the TV of the same 32-cell categorical service-level symbol law
guarantees.eps_lo: asymptotic Michel HPLB estimate for the TV of that same 32-cell categorical service-level symbol law; not an exact finite-sample certificate

protocol.object: For each retained APP service, draw one eligible flow uniformly from the test-period service population and map its first five (direction,size) symbols to one of the fixed 32 categorical cells; the timing channel is excluded.

reproduction_verdict.assessment: The raw QUIC22 fraction is a measured non-reproduction of the primary fraction under the fixed protocol, with tuning_performed false. It is a composition-affected marginal comparison because the two corpora have different service counts and min-n distributions; the requested n-stratified table is required before treating the difference as a corpus property.
reproduction_verdict.interpretation_boundary: Do not call the raw difference single-corpus non-extrapolability. The upper side is a finite-sample distribution-free certificate; the Michel lower side is an asymptotic HPLB estimate, not an exact finite-sample certificate. Therefore the joint gate is a mixed-strength two-sided measurement and must not be described as an exact finite-sample two-sided certificate.

lower_guarantee.guarantee: asymptotic HPLB estimate; not an exact finite-sample certificate
lower_guarantee.signature: (X1: 'Sequence[Sequence[float]]', X2: 'Sequence[Sequence[float]]', alpha: 'float' = 0.05, clf: 'Any | None' = None, *, test_size: 'float' = 0.3, random_state: 'int' = 0, method: 'str' = 'michel', michel_grid_points: 'int' = 1001) -> 'tuple[float, dict[str, Any]]'

source_object.channel: (direction,size) only; PPI[1] direction and PPI[2] size; PPI[0] excluded
source_object.packing: first k=5 (direction,size) symbols -> packed index in [0,32) -> one-hot

scan.sample_unit: one eligible flow from one APP service

inferred_channels.what_the_3_means: PPI leading dimension is three measured packet channels. Project dataset notes state first-30-packet sequences contain packet size, direction, and inter-packet time; artifact statistics identify row 1 as direction, row 2 as size, and row 0 as the remaining timing-like channel. Only direction and size are used for this readout.

sample_size_disclosure.upper_side_n: full (all eligible test flows per service, uncapped)
sample_size_disclosure.lower_side_n: capped at 20000 flows per service (sample_seed=20260913, method=michel, random_state=0)
sample_size_disclosure.bias_direction: CONSERVATIVE — a lower bound with less data is weaker (smaller eps_lo), so the cap can only shrink eps_lo and understate the joint gate. The reported 15.75% is therefore a lower bound on the true joint-gate fraction, not inflated.
sample_size_disclosure.D065_class_note: Two bounds at different n must not sit in one table without saying so. The upper side uses full n; the lower side uses min(n, 20000). The joint gate ANDs the two.
